shortDescription: Install/Update packages using IBM Installation Manager

options.name: iim_path
options.description: Absolute path to an existing installation of IBM Installation Manager

options.name: path
options.description: Absolute path where the package should be installed

options.name: preferences
options.description: A dictionary to be passed to the installer as preferences flag

options.name: product_id
options.description: Product ID to be installed/updated/deleted. May be product family, or a specific product ID instance (including FixPack details)

options.name: properties
options.description: A dictionary to be passed to the installer as properties flag

options.name: repos
options.description: List of repositories to include when installing the package(s) specified by C(product_id)

options.name: shared_resources
options.description: Absolute path to an existing location of the shared resources directory for IIM

options.name: state
options.description: Desired state of the package denoted by C(product_id)
